The [[Armageddon Lord]]s are shepherds of the [[Titan]]s that lead the forces of the [[Lich Lord]] through the portals he opened to the major cities on [[Tyria]]. When slain, each will produce a level 28 [[Risen Ashen Hulk]].

==Notes==
*They share a model with the warriors [[Burning Titan]]s and drop warrior [[tome]]s, but are actually closer to elementalists regarding their armor ratings and skills.

==Trivia==
*Before the [[Game updates/20050907|September 7, 2005 update]], Armageddon Lords did not spawn Risen Ashen Hulk on death.
*At level 42 these are the highest-level foes in Guild Wars along with [[Arm of the Titans|Arms]] and [[Fist of the Titans|Fists of the Titans]].
